related.title: Caliper：比例的加總與時間加權聚合
related.titleEn: Caliper: ratios of sums and time-weighted aggregation
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：報告不把CPU百分比當總體加速；兩種時間均有原始記錄與適用條件。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The report does not turn a CPU percentage into overall speedup; both timing quantities retain raw evidence and applicability limits.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「Caliper：比例的加總與時間加權聚合」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付兩版原始列、群組鍵、加總帳本及等時間格核對；明示這是active-rank平均率，不把它放到job throughput欄位。
related.differenceEn: Investigate Caliper: ratios of sums and time-weighted aggregation using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver both raw row sets, grouping keys, sum ledgers and equal-time-cell checks. Label the result as an active-rank average rate rather than placing it under job throughput.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 將children50ms拆成20與30ms，其他工作40ms；與父self30ms合計120ms，再核對父inclusive80ms及25%自身占比。
先計每列100與20，再算未加權平均60；另外從work與active_seconds加總得28，將差異連回1秒與9秒的權重。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Split child cost into twenty and thirty milliseconds and assign forty milliseconds to other work. Add those leaf costs to thirty milliseconds of parent self time, then reconcile the 120 ms CPU total, 80 ms parent inclusive time and self percentage.

Calculate row rates of one hundred and twenty and their unweighted mean of sixty. Separately sum work and active time to obtain twenty-eight, and trace the disagreement to one second versus nine seconds of exposure rather than treating one expression as universally correct.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Perlmutter：異質佇列的完成時間與資料就緒
related.titleEn: Perlmutter: heterogeneous queue time and data readiness
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：報告不把CPU百分比當總體加速；兩種時間均有原始記錄與適用條件。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The report does not turn a CPU percentage into overall speedup; both timing quantities retain raw evidence and applicability limits.
related.difference: 以選項、等待估計時間戳、運算秒數、資料雜湊建立決策表；兩個二進位都先通過相同數值容差。
related.differenceEn: Build alternatives.csv with an option, timestamped wait estimate, runtime and input hash. Require both executables to pass the same numerical tolerance before treating them as interchangeable scheduling choices.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 將children50ms拆成20與30ms，其他工作40ms；與父self30ms合計120ms，再核對父inclusive80ms及25%自身占比。
單階段估計完成時間為等待加運算；估計值必須有相同起點且包含資料已就緒的前提；CPU 路徑等待 60 秒、執行 540 秒；GPU 執行 120 秒，等待由 900 改為 300 秒；名義式 900+120 = 1020 s；變更式 300+120 = 420 s。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Split child cost into twenty and thirty milliseconds and assign forty milliseconds to other work. Add those leaf costs to thirty milliseconds of parent self time, then reconcile the 120 ms CPU total, 80 ms parent inclusive time and self percentage.

For the deliberately single-stage fixture, completion estimate equals queue wait plus execution time. All estimates share a submission timestamp and assume required data are already staged and verified. The CPU alternative waits 60 seconds and runs for 540. The GPU alternative runs for 120 seconds; its estimated wait changes from 900 to 300. These values are invented, not NERSC queue predictions. Nominal 900+120 = 1020 s; changed 300+120 = 420 s. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
